title: CPR songs between 100-120 BPM!
description:
“Stayin’ Alive” is a classic CPR beat, but it’s not the only one! Songs between 100–120 BPM can help you keep the right rhythm during chest compressions. 

Whether you love pop, country, or hip-hop, there’s a track for you that will save a life! Which song would you choose?

#CPR #HeartHealth #SanDiego
